<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
solve(a, b) -> 'core.SymbolicTensor'
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Solve linear systems `a x = b` (numpy `linalg.solve` semantics).

## Parameters

- `a` — `SymbolicTensor` of shape `(..., n, n)`.

- `b` — `SymbolicTensor` of shape `(..., n)` or `(..., n, k)`.

## Returns

- `'core.SymbolicTensor'` — `SymbolicTensor` with `b`'s shape (with the last axis of `a` consumed); dtype follows numpy (integer inputs → `float64`, else `promote_dtypes(a.dtype, b.dtype)`).

## Raises

- `core.TraceError` — no active trace; concrete `Tensor` operand.

- `core.ShapeError` — rank < 2 for `a`; non-square static dims; static
  batch mismatch.
